originalTitle: China industrial profits post strongest growth in three months, rising 14.4%
summary: The global AI boom and higher commodity prices stemming from the war in Iran have lifted earnings at miners, chipmakers and raw-material suppliers.
content:
China's industrial profits grew at their strongest pace since June, as a boom in manufacturing tied to artificial intelligence offset drag from persistently weak domestic demand.

Profits at large industrial firms rose 14.4% last month from a year earlier, official data released Tuesday showed. For the first nine months of this year, industrial profits climbed 15.5%, slightly below the 15.7% rise in the January-September period.

The strength comes as industrial earnings swung to double-digit growth earlier this year, following a modest gain in 2025 after three straight years of declines, helped by Beijing's efforts to curb rampant price wars across sectors and surging demand for AI-related equipment.

The global AI boom and higher commodity prices stemming from the war in Iran have lifted earnings at miners, chipmakers and raw-material suppliers this year, even as downstream manufacturers face rising input costs and weak domestic demand.

Earnings growth in high-tech sectors, such as AI and robotics, has been outperforming profits in consumer-related industries, including clothing, autos and furniture.

China's economy expanded 4.5% in the third quarter from a year earlier, slightly faster than the previous quarter, taking growth in the first nine months to 4.6%, within the government's full-year target range of 4.5% to 5%.

Consumption remains soft, with retail sales growing 1.1% in September, beating forecasts but only marginally above August's weak reading.

With concerns mounting over local government debt and the benefits of consumer trade-in subsidies fading, Beijing has so far held back from major new stimulus for domestic demand.

High-tech manufacturing investment and electronics capacity utilization remain resilient, supported by the global AI cycle and domestic policy priorities, said Shena Yue, senior economist at Oxford Economics. Overall investment and industrial utilization are still subdued, she said.

Household demand is the weak link as the property downturn continues to weigh on housing purchases and related durables, Yue said.

"China's export strength isn't able to fully offset its domestic weakness," she said.
chineseTitle: 中国工业利润创三个月来最强劲增长 增长14.4%
chineseSummary: 全球人工智能的繁荣和伊朗战争引发的大宗商品价格上涨提高了矿商、芯片制造商和原材料供应商的收益。
chineseContent:
由于与人工智能相关的制造业繁荣抵消了国内需求持续疲弱的拖累，中国工业利润以六月份以来最强劲的速度增长。

周二公布的官方数据显示，上个月大型工业企业利润同比增长 14.4%。今年前9个月，工业利润增长15.5%，略低于1-9月15.7%的增幅。

这一强劲势头之际，得益于中国政府遏制各行业猖獗的价格战以及人工智能相关设备需求激增的努力，工业盈利在连续三年下滑后，于 2025 年小幅增长，​​今年早些时候转向两位数增长。

尽管下游制造商面临投入成本上升和国内需求疲软，但全球人工智能的繁荣和伊朗战争引发的大宗商品价格上涨，提振了矿商、芯片制造商和原材料供应商今年的盈利。

人工智能和机器人等高科技行业的盈利增长一直超过服装、汽车和家具等消费相关行业的利润。

中国经济第三季度同比增长4.5%，略快于上一季度，前9个月增速达到4.6%，符合政府4.5%至5%的全年目标范围。

消费依然疲软，9 月份零售额增长 1.1%，超出预期，但仅略高于 8 月份的疲软数据。

随着对地方政府债务的担忧日益加剧，以及消费者以旧换新补贴的好处逐渐消失，中国政府迄今为止一直没有采取新的重大内需刺激措施。

牛津经济研究院高级经济学家 Shena Yue 表示，在全球人工智能周期和国内政策优先事项的支持下，高科技制造业投资和电子产能利用率保持弹性。她表示，总体投资和工业利用仍然低迷。

岳表示，由于房地产低迷继续影响住房购买和相关耐用品，因此家庭需求是薄弱环节。

“中国的出口实力无法完全抵消国内的疲软，”她说。
whyItMatters: 这条信息属于财经市场信号，适合用于观察利率、汇率、股债商品、金融机构和宏观政策变化。
